reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Great flight to and from Bali. On time both ways. However we didnt get a notification that the return flight had been brought forward by 2 hours.
reviews.author: ims69Perth

reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: They shifted my flight schedule from evening to morning! And they said there's only one flight that day...so inconvenient would not recommend this plane at all
reviews.author: vina

reviews.title: Terrible service and no communication
reviews.text: We bought tickets to go to Labuan Bajo and Citlink moved the flight up 3 hours without telling me or my 3 other passengers. When we went to the citilink desk, there were 10 other passengers besides us that this had happened too. Ladies behind the desk did little to no effort to find out why this happened or to resolve the issue. Absolutely terrible service and do NOT recommend!
reviews.author: Joe Y

reviews.title: Facemasks
reviews.text: Yep, still required throughout the flight. Why? Dont ask, dont argue. Pointless covid theatre years after they were proven useless. Rest of the service is fine, staff friendly.
reviews.author: paul s

reviews.title: Poor communication and unprofessional behavior by the staff
reviews.text: When I wanted to board the plane at DPS I was informed by the staff that due to a new policy, masks are now required on board their flights. I was sent to a shop to buy some facial masks and then had to queue again in order to board the flight. This new policy was not communicated before at any point in time. When I complained about this the staff just ignored me which shows the lack of care for their customers...
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: Flight was delayed twice and we were sent to the wrong terminal twice. No communication at all. Sketchy plane trip would not recommend at all.
reviews.author: Isaac G

reviews.title: canceled flight by Citilink
reviews.text: DO NOT BOOK YOUR FLIGHT WITH CITILINK. If they cancel your flight, you do not get a refund and they frustrate all your attempts to reach them. Our flight was canceled bij Citilink. Edreams tried to contact Citilink about a refund without any succes. Later on we have tried to contact them through email and Whatsapp., ofcourse also without any succes. They read (mailtrack) your emails but do not answer. If you use the chat or whatsapp they act as if they do not understand (anything) your problem and say you have to contact someone else. Really strange for a daughter organisation of Garuda.
reviews.author: Kees B

reviews.title: Insane Delays
reviews.text: A month ago, delayed for 3 hrs. Today, they rescheduled from my 9am flight to 17:35pm. And then, delayed it by further hour again! What’s going on with this flight?! WARNING: If traveling from JOGJA to JAKARTA, never, ever choose Citilink. “Operational Delays” are insane. They literally give you little tea and small biscuits for compensation, no refunds. I will never choose Citilink again.
reviews.author: PB

reviews.title: Horrible horrible horrible
reviews.text: Please do not use Citilink services. You book your ticket, and then they reschedule the flights so that you have to travel to and fro on the same day. And then they make you follow up with on call and email for a refund- which costs a bomb if you are not from the country. It would be better to give the money to charity than to this company that cheats people of their hard earned money!! Tourists please stay away from this company!
reviews.author: Daisy Antony

reviews.title: Boarding delay more than2 hours !
reviews.text: Scheduled departure 6:10 pm, departure 8:30 pm. Horrible airline . I fly from singapore to Bali transiting in surabaya. Surabaya Juanda international airport terminal 1 and 2 are separated. No shuttle service from citylink, I must come out from immigration , grabbing a taxi to terminal 1. Check in again ! Such a fantastic service and connection service provided by citylink. Upon arrival at terminal 1, more than 2 hours delay ! Awesome 4 star low cost carrier
reviews.author: Sam S

reviews.title: Very good customer service at the check in counter, served by Joshy Joshe.
reviews.text: The check in process is very smooth. Was served by a very friendly and accommodating service officer, Joshy Joshe. Joshy made us very welcoming and he was very patient with us although there was a slight glitch in accessing our e-tickets and vaccination records. kids and elderly have priority to enter the plane. The seats are comfortable with enough leg space. Overall: two thumbs up to Joshy and Citilink!
reviews.author: Ellableu H

reviews.title: THEY CANCELLED THE FLIGHT AND NEVER REFOUND YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: SCAM! its a scam to steal your money. they canceled my flight and never gave me my money back. they will give you a voucher which is useless because I don't live in Indonesia. the process to get the voucher is very hard because the OTP number they send to you never works. stay away from this scam company
reviews.author: 671max739

reviews.title: Lovely LCC with food for free
reviews.text: The flight was on time and flight attendants courteous. leg room was not good yes but this is what is expected for a LCC. they served free food onboard and is quite OK.
reviews.author: LukeY

reviews.title: Always delay
reviews.text: Poor service, ground handling staff can't help passenger with any information, always delay. Passenger wait the previous flight passager disembark at the boarding bridge (garbarata) and we get in the flight without any sanitize treatment.
reviews.author: Prima Happyani

reviews.title: Terrible customer service, hidden baggage fees
reviews.text: I recently I had a terrible experience with Citilink Airlines in Singapore. The staff at the check-in counter were rude enough to tell me that "Economy"---so long as Citilink was in Singpore--was now called "Free and Easy." "Free and Easy" travelers apparently are not allowed the 20K baggage allowed FREE for economy travelers within the country of Indonesia. This "FREE AND EASY" concept was not explained change in the ticket.com website where I bought the ticket. The ticket lists me as "Economy" class, which should have allowed me 20K of check-in baggage. Otherwise I would not, I repeat I would not have, purchased this budget ticket that allowed no other amenities. The check in staff had me pay an extra $80 for a 16 kilo bag I assumed would come free with the ticket, as ALL ECONOMY TICKETS ARE WITHIN THE COUNTRY OF INDONESIA. An outrage. I want my money back immediately. For those flying Citilink anywhere outside of Indonesia, watch out for hidden fees. They'll get you!
reviews.author: J Alexandra

reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.text: First time using this airline and pleasantly surprised. Compared with other low-cost airlines, I have found the customer service extremely good. Knowing that the flight was delayed by a few hours, the staff did everything they could so I didn't miss my connection with another airline (Scoot) at Penang airport. I was surprised, cause usually airlines don't care since you are using another airline afterwards. In this case, they arranged for a staff to pick me up straight from the plane to the boarding gate. He helped me skip all the queue at customers etc. Without their help I would have missed my flight 100%. Thanks again! Also, unlike other low cost airlines, this one is not tacky and actually quite classy. The hostesses are also very pretty! I can only give 4 stars since the flight was delayed...
reviews.author: Gerald

reviews.title: 2 days before flight cancelled and no refund
reviews.text: 2 days before my trip from bali to sorong, they cancelled my flight and didn’t give me another option. They refused to give a refund, they told us that they would give another flight 2 days after that one cancelled, but we had a tour for a whole week in raja ampat, we coudn’t go later. I needed to buy new tickets with other airline and pay so much more money. I talked with locals and they say that this airline do that a lot on purpose. YOU STOLE MY MONEY AND TIME
reviews.author: Catarina

reviews.title: 3 hours late
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed 3 hours and we had to change gate four time. So all the people going from gate to gate.. People on the gates did not know anything about the elay and even when we finally were boarding on the screen was text that we are in time!
reviews.author: Satu H

reviews.title: Rescheduled the flight two times in a row
reviews.text: Citilink didn't hold their good reputation. The airline didn't have delays but made an earlier departure than the original hour. I have had two rescheduled flights from Surabaya to Jakarta, which were problematic. My flight QG 711 was supposed to take off at 6.30 am but changed to 5.10 am. The latest flight I took, QZ 731, was changed from 7.30 am to 6.00 am. The notice came in less than 24 hours. When I arrived in Jakarta last week, the airline didn't get my luggage out to the belt along with the rest of the passengers. I have to ask a Citilink staff about my suitcase. She was rude and irritated in checking the status of my luggage. Finally, after waiting for another extra hour, it came out solo. I hope this bad habit of playing with customers' time won't continue because it is truly disturbing.
reviews.author: Kaca Jiwa

reviews.title: Service deterioration
reviews.text: Flight was rescheduled and makes the connecting flight void, then the flight itself was delayed, while it’s rival flight SJ and Lion Air fly on time. At CGK, the baggage claim take an hour, the staff was very very slow.
reviews.author: PSBWatoni

reviews.title: Bad experience with agent and delay flight
reviews.text: So disappointed with citilink agent since she cut the conversation between us and i received a mail that my flight delay for 45 minutes. And I asked for change the flight to be another time which is near with my original flight time since i have airport drop and pick up booking paid already and cannot cancel. But the CS say no and didnt give any solution. Not even allowed to give conversations to the manager.
reviews.author: nindi s

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE
reviews.text: Will never fly citilink again. All of their flights are delayed. Time is money. The seats I paid for were unavailable but I paid for them. Baggage scaled goes up and down and is not working properly. They charge me 4 kilos over and tried originally to charge me over 6 kilos. Worst airline.
reviews.author: Jlynnjacobson

reviews.title: SCAM! YOU WOULD BE LIKELY FORCED TO RESCHEDULE WITH THE WORSE TIME POSSIBLE
reviews.text: Dont fly with them. Theyre the worse! Scammers! I planned my whole vacation for months and they ruined it just in time I am about to go! Insane!
reviews.author: Rosa

reviews.title: Go Royal Green
reviews.text: To be honest, I was going to pick Garuda, but couldn't find a matching flight for my time. So I ended up with Citylink since I didn't want to fly with the other domestic airlines and they are of course part of Garuda. My tip is, just go for Royal Green Class. So can make use of the special check-in desk, fast track, priority boarding and you get this nice food box during the flight. I also was surprised that on the plane I was addressed by my name and the lead flight attendant introduced herself in person to all Royal Green Class travellers. I had seat 1D, combined with the free middle seat I had plenty of legroom. Overall good experience for an affordable price.
reviews.author: Jordy T

reviews.title: Flight cancelled. Good luck with that...
reviews.text: 30Jul2021 QG633 LBJ-CGK cancelled due to .... Nobody knows. Zero notification. The funny thing was that the security guy at LBJ airport knew more than the Citilink guy. Citilink dude told me I needed to pay for the rebooking. Ha. I'm not the one who cancelled the flight and didn't tell anyone. Never flying Citilink again. I'll take my chances on some other carrier. Another interesting tidbit, Citilink was awarded Public Relations Indonesia Award (PRIA) 2021. Shows the level of public relations in Indonesia.
reviews.author: Banquet Guest

reviews.title: Worst company in the history of travel
reviews.text: Told back in March 2020 before covid was bad in Aus or Bali that our flight was cancelled and a refund will be given. i have filed the paperwork 3 times now and they are not replying to emails, facebook messsages or instagram. i am owed over $1100 for flights that they cancelled not me.
reviews.author: haiz90

reviews.title: Bad customer service and overall unethical company
reviews.text: Avoid like plaque. They treat customer really bad from the front office, call centre etc. Pay less or bit extra for other airlines. This airlines is knly in it to suck your money
reviews.author: Alex Z

reviews.title: Very annoying baggage policy
reviews.text: My suitcase was not cabin size, the check in table didnt say anything and then suddenly when i was about to enter the plane, theres this very rude attendant forcing me to check my baggage in while dragging the so called “cabin size” standard. They mention its a full flight and that there will be no space in the plane. Its a big lie... i saw people dragging luggage and backpack bigger than mone into the plane. This airline is not worth the 4 star skytrax airline low cost award. No social distancing also. On top of that our gate was moved but i think this is a common practise in indonesia, they cant decide which gate is for which.
reviews.author: Christy A

reviews.title: NO SOCIAL DISTANCING SEAT AT FRONT ROW PAYMENT
reviews.text: Mind as well don’t ask us to use mask. I bought online the seat FOR 135k IDR and it was only for 2 seat at selling online. But then on board it WAS FULL PACKED. Plus the woman who should be assisting us as A HELPER is so RUDE, said all the mean stuff like no it’s full unlike the online you thought with 2 seats! And make fun of it with her girl friends. So no social distancing and deal with it!! I SHALL NOT BUY CITILINK FIRST PLACE IF I DIDNT READ CAREFULLY ABOUT THE ANTI SOCIAL DISTANCING. This is is stupid. And the staff is so unfriendly. Thanks
reviews.author: Tequila

reviews.title: Citilink cancelled my flight and refund process was non-existent
reviews.text: The airline single-handedly canceled my flight. Notification was sent through a text message with an instruction to call customer service for a refund. I called their customer service multiple times. English proficiency was terrible and so communication was difficult. Customer service told me they will send a link to request for a refund but they never did. I got tired of waiting and repeatedly calling and emailing this airline. This airline is a MASSIVE SCAM.
reviews.author: Yanti M
